# Tiny Quest
A tiny offline JavaScript project for demonstrating real coding tasks.
reward adds a bonus to a coin reward. slots adds bag capacity. heal caps health at 100.
Use npm test. No dependencies, network or commits.
health.mjs: export function heal(hp, potion) { return Math.min(100, hp + potion); }
pack.mjs: export function slots(items, extra) { return items + extra; }
quest.mjs: export function reward(coins, bonus) { return coins + bonus; }
